subject: Composed workflow query and observation acceptance pipeline

covered_boundaries: provider success without immutable run identity fails closed
newest matching exact-commit run is selected
acceptance requires exact commit, completed success, immutable identity, and required artifacts

claim_boundary.proved: The composed module deterministically carries a workflow query result into the existing exact-commit observation gate and preserves fail-closed decisions across both stages.
not_proved: A provider workflow run exists for the current commit.
Required artifacts exist in GitHub Actions.
Browser or physical-device audio is audible.

privacy_boundary: Synthetic workflow metadata only; no credentials, private chat material, user health data, or provider secrets are stored.
